name: Sandalwood
notes: fact: Pires valued a bahar of white sandalwood at 1½ cruzados at Melaka (docs/research/prices.md §3; Pires II, p. 272).
inference: Java-linked eastern shipments are a proxy for sandalwood replenishment, not a dated Timor arrival series (docs/research/prices.md §4.1; docs/research/monsoon-calendar.md §5).
gameplay: Base index from docs/research/prices.md §5; the monthly and stock percentages are tuning values, not historical prices or rates.
